services.name: RV Sites
services.desc: There’s nothing better than pulling into your site after a long day on the road, leveling out, setting up your chairs, and taking a deep breath of fresh Black Hills air. At Happy Holiday RV Resort, our RV sites are designed to make arrival easy and your stay comfortable. Located just 14 miles from Mount Rushmore and 5 miles from Rapid City, our year-round RV park gives you a central base camp without the congestion of busier tourist areas. You’ll spend less time navigating traffic and more time enjoying your trip. We know RV travelers value simple, stress-free access. Evenings end around the campfire beneath a wide South Dakota sky. At Happy Holiday RV Resort, our log cabins blend rustic charm with the convenience of being just minutes from Mount Rushmore. Located only 14 miles from Mount Rushmore and 5 miles from Rapid City, our cabins offer the perfect balance - a peaceful setting that still keeps you close to the region’s most iconic attractions.
